implementation: Local-shadow ranking by range, brightness and authored opacity, with per-scan frustum reuse
hardware: Linux x86_64, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 / NVIDIA 580.178.04, Godot 4.7 5b4e0cb0f with local engine patches

formula.zero_or_invalid_strength: ineligible, including held incumbents; examined on the next normal scan

measurement_method.shadow_signal: For each light, hold shadow_enabled true and compare opacity 0 versus opacity 1. Sum absolute RGB differences, then report the sum for actually selected lights divided by the sum for all candidates. No scoring formula is used to measure image impact.
measurement_method.pass_boundary: Also compare each zero-opacity light pass against all shadow flags disabled; report this separately from shadow signal.
measurement_method.selection_cost: 64 warmup scans plus 256 timed actual _assign_shadows calls for each of 16/64/128 lights, headless; baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline. Table uses the mean of two per-run medians. Not whole-frame/GPU timing.

limitations: Importance is a range/strength/distance heuristic, not an actual screen-space receiver or caster query. The large retained-signal changes belong only to two controlled diagnostic scenes.
The reference scheduler weights work/allocation; its four-lamp work budget is not the remake resident limit.
The native per-object light limit can remove a candidate contribution. Four-light desktop override results are not physical Android/browser validation.
Same enabled-light count does not guarantee same shadow GPU cost: selected wider ranges may include more casters. No whole-game FPS/VRAM saving is claimed.
Full-map visual/device acceptance, caster-aware selection, native Mobile fades, and static/dynamic shadow map caching remain open.
Camera snapshot reuse lasts only one synchronous scan; it is recreated for later camera/terrain scans. No map or frustum is retained across scans.
World/option/lifetime ownership, fade policies and gameplay properties are unchanged. The other checkout was read and checked only.
